note.title: CSV Export for Filtered Reports
note.summary: The dashboard now allows users to export filtered reports in CSV format, enabling them to download only the rows that match their applied filters. This feature enhances data management and reporting efficiency.
changes: Introduced CSV export functionality for filtered reports.
Users can now apply filters and download only the matching rows.

note.title: Activity API Pagination Support
note.summary: The Activity API has been enhanced to support pagination, allowing developers to retrieve results in a more manageable format. This update introduces 'page' and 'page_size' parameters for improved data handling.
changes: Added 'page' parameter to the Activity API for specifying the page number of results.
Introduced 'page_size' parameter to control the number of results returned per page.

note.title: Session Timeout Configuration Update
note.summary: Administrators can now configure the session timeout duration directly from the security settings page, enhancing control over user sessions and security protocols.
changes: Added a new option for configuring session timeout duration.
Updated the security settings page to include session timeout configuration.

note.title: Offline Content Viewing Feature
note.summary: The mobile app now allows users to access previously loaded content even when they are temporarily offline, enhancing the user experience by providing uninterrupted access to important information.
changes: Introduced offline content viewing capability for previously loaded items.
Improved app performance during offline mode.
Updated user interface to indicate offline content availability.
Added notifications for users when switching to offline mode.

note.title: Exact Phrase Matching in Search
note.summary: We are excited to introduce a new feature that enhances the search functionality by allowing users to perform exact phrase matching. By enclosing search phrases in quotation marks, users can now find results that match their queries more precisely, improving the overall search experience.
changes: Added support for exact phrase matching in search queries.
Users can now enclose phrases in quotation marks to retrieve exact matches.

note.title: Monthly Billing Invoices PDF Download Feature

note.title: Draft Restoration Feature

citations: User feedback on draft loss issues
